1 Cf. quae praecedunt in cod. Berol. infra descripto.
2 Praeter haec capita idem codex exhibet fol. 112: περὶ σπορᾶς ἐκ τῶν ῥητορίου.
Inc. : τοῦ ζωδιακοῦ εἰς τξ' μοίρας διῃρημένου. Des. : δεῖ ζητεῖν τῆς συλλήψεως.
Edam ex codice Paris. 2506 qui idem caput praebet fol. 23r. De re vide Antiochum
apud Porphyrium, p. 194, 8 sqq.; Heph. Theb., II, 1 (p. 24 Engelbr.).
sections.en: 1 Compare the things which precede in the Berlin codex described below. 2 Besides these chapters the same codex exhibits on fol. 112: περὶ σπορᾶς ἐκ τῶν ῥητορίου ('on sowing from the things of Rhetorius'). Incipit: τοῦ ζωδιακοῦ εἰς τξ' μοίρας διῃρημένου ('of the zodiac divided into 360 degrees'). Desinit: δεῖ ζητεῖν τῆς συλλήψεως ('it is necessary to seek the conception'). I will publish it from the Paris codex 2506 which offers the same chapter on fol. 23r. Concerning the matter see Antiochus in Porphyry, p. 194, 8 ff.; Heph. Theb., II, 1 (p. 24 Engelbr.).

summary.headline: Rhetorius Manuscript Collation
summary.text: Description and collation of Florentine and other Greek codices transmitting Rhetorius’s exposition and solution concerning the twelve zodiac signs, drawn from the treasuries of Antiochus. Manuscripts Laur. XXVIII, 34; Laur. XXVIII, 7; Monac. 170 and 105; Vatic. 1444; Marcianus 335, 336, and 324 are compared by chapter contents and folio or page ranges.
